author: htcfreek

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: The plugin trusts net.exe exit rather than the final service state.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: Use SCM state and accurate outcome reporting.

judgment.rationale: The issue was reproduced by a maintainer, who found the behavior specific to the net.exe path and reported that ServiceController did not trigger the same restart. Current source still shells out to net and treats exit code 0 as success without waiting for ServiceController.Status.
evidence: Maintainer reproduced with Windows Search and Windows Update services and identified immediate restart after net.exe.
Current ServiceHelper.ChangeStatus launches elevated net start/stop and shows success solely from process exit code.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a design to perform service operations through an elevated ServiceController path and report only the verified final status.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix covers the unchanged command-exit versus final-state bug.

proposed_fixes.title: Verify and control service state instead of trusting net.exe exit
proposed_fixes.root_cause: ServiceHelper.ChangeStatus interprets a successful `net stop` process exit as a stopped service without observing its post-command ServiceController status; for affected services the SCM immediately returns them to running.
plan: Move start/stop/restart into the existing elevated execution boundary using ServiceController or an equivalent SCM API.
Wait with a bounded timeout for the requested ServiceControllerStatus and refresh the result afterward.
Report “stopped” only if the final state is Stopped; otherwise explain that Windows restarted or rejected the transition.
verification: Unit-test final-state classification for stopped, restarted, timeout, and access-denied outcomes using a service abstraction.
Manually test Windows Search and Windows Update on a disposable machine with recovery/start triggers noted.
Verify UAC cancellation and restart preserve accurate notifications.

confidence.rationale: The maintainer reproduction and unchanged net.exe/exit-code implementation directly identify the false-success mechanism.

issue_context.summary: The Service plugin reports a successful stop when `net stop` exits successfully even if Windows immediately restarts the service, so the notification describes the command result rather than the observed final service state.
known_information: The plugin can display “Service is stopped” while the service remains running.
The issue was reproduced for wsearch and wuauserv.
Current code uses `net`/`cmd`, waits for process exit, and maps exit code 0 directly to a success notification.
inferences: SCM status verification is required even if the implementation retains net.exe; ServiceController is the cleaner control path suggested by the maintainer.
issue_context.analysis: The code still implements the exact mechanism identified in the discussion, so this is an implementation-ready design candidate rather than an information request.
